findings.failure_path: The final merged trigger changes the catalog after the affected-owner regression pass. The README explicitly records that seventeen of this owner's twenty-one expected-owner cases were measured only on the intermediate catalog, and no final full-bank run covers them. Because the packet itself demonstrates that a trigger change can move unrelated cases, intermediate results cannot establish final routing compatibility. This leaves a material acceptance-evidence gap under the required final-wording and neighbor checks.
findings.smallest_fix: Measure the seventeen omitted cases on the final catalog using at least the documented neighbor sample size, compare with the supplied base observations, and resolve any regression candidates through the documented paired-probe process.
